meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale, and I'd like to know why my son found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class. Who decided that, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I don't have time for this. The zero stands.
Then you've decided before anyone heard Owen. On what basis, Hale, and under which procedure?
Sorry. That came out wrong. Let me show you what I actually have: the essay quotes a line that isn't in Hamlet, and his October 15 outline argued cowardice, which the essay never mentions.
I'm writing that down, Hale. Which line, and where does it appear in the essay? Put the outline and the essay in front of me, because I don't take anyone's word for a document.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and the essay and the outline in my hands to check. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to see the essay and the outline for herself.
What moved her: Nothing moved her position yet, but saying sorry and then naming a specific dated piece of Owen's work got her asking real questions, because it gave her something she could check once she sees it.
What cost ground: Opening with the zero stands and no time for this, because it confirmed her belief that the decision came before anyone heard Owen.
Try next time: Open by owning that the zero went in before you called her, then put the essay and the October 15 outline in front of her in the same breath.
